purpose: Teach: 伊勢/明日香/日テレ/タール/プラハ/瀬戸/譚/挿絵

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さん、本気で、絶対、伊勢、絶対、お参り、絶対、お連れくださったぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: Gran, do you remember? When you were young, your father — he took us to Ise Shrine. He was absolutely determined about it.
lines.style: Slow, tender opening. Voice catches slightly on the memory. Gentle insistence — not questioning her memory but inviting her into it. Warm pause before the final affirmation.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、明日香、絶対、奈良の、絶対、史跡、絶対、お好きだったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Oh yes, I do remember. Your grandfather — when he was young, he was so fond of those Asuka sights in Nara. You remember that, don't you? He truly was.
lines.style: Bright recall lighting up her voice. Conversational but careful — she's reaching back through time. Gentle emphasis on the shared memory. Trailing warmth, checking that he's with her.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、ばあさん、本気で、絶対、日テレ、絶対、の、絶対、お番組、絶対、お好きだったわよな、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: When you were young, Gran was absolutely devoted to that NTV program. You remember, don't you? She really was.
lines.style: Softer now, almost teasing in tone. The affection underneath is unmistakable. Voice has a slight smile — he's sharing something he's held onto. Small pause before the confirmation.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、タール、絶対、舗装、絶対、お父さんの仕事、絶対、思い出したわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Oh, that's right — your grandfather, when he was young, he would think back to his father's work with the tar and asphalt. You remember that, don't you? He truly did.
lines.style: Delighted recognition. Her voice brightens — she's adding her own piece to the tapestry. Warm, almost conspiratorial. The 'don't you' is gentle, not insistent.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、ばあさんと、本気で、絶対、プラハ、絶対、お旅行、絶対、夢に見たぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: When you were young, Gran and I — we both dreamed about traveling to Prague. Do you remember that? We really did.
lines.style: Voice softens with the shared dream. Almost vulnerable — he's offering something tender. Slower pace on 'Prague.' The final affirmation is quiet conviction, not debate.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、瀬戸、絶対、焼きの、絶対、お皿、絶対、お好きだったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Oh yes — your grandfather, when he was young, he loved Seto pottery so much. Those beautiful plates. You remember, don't you? He truly did.
lines.style: Warm, almost dreamy. She's painting the picture as she speaks. Lingers gently on the image of the plates. Her 'don't you' is an invitation to see what she sees.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、ばあさん、本気で、絶対、古い小説の、絶対、譚、絶対、お読みになったぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: When you were young, Gran read all those old novel tales to you. You remember that, don't you? She really did.
lines.style: Voice carries the weight of shared time. Respectful, almost reverential about the stories. Slower delivery — these are not casual memories. Quiet conviction at the end.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、絵本の、絶対、挿絵、絶対、お孫さんに、絶対、見せられたわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Oh, I certainly did — your grandfather, when he was young, he showed the grandchildren all those beautiful picture book illustrations. You remember that, don't you? He truly was so generous with them.
lines.style: Her warmest delivery yet. Genuine delight in the memory. Voice opens up on 'illustrations.' The final line has a small, satisfied exhale — the memory is complete and precious.
